request.description: Update incident status only. incident_status (required): OPEN, ASSIGNED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, REOPENED. When CLOSED, sets resolved_by, resolved_date, closed_date. Vendor users can only set CLOSED for their vendor's incidents.

Bulk update incident status. date (required, Y-m-d): if date is today updates SanitationIncidentsModel, otherwise SanitationIncidentsArchiveModel. incident_status (required): OPEN, ASSIGNED, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED, REOPENED. incident_ids (required): array of incident_id. When CLOSED, sets resolved_by, resolved_date, closed_date for all.

query.description: Required. Y-m-d (inspection date for under/off monitoring)

request.description: Returns total_toilets, registered_toilets, under_monitoring (at least one inspection on date), off_monitoring (no inspection on date). Cached when AppConfig cache enabled.
Inspection report with filters: asset_types, date_from, date_to, vendor, asset, gsd (swachhagrahi), shift. Cached when AppConfig cache enabled.

query.description: asset_type | sector | vendor | date (empty = raw rows)

request.description: Summary report with filters. group_by: asset_type (asset type wise), sector (sector wise), vendor (vendor wise), date (date wise). Cached when AppConfig cache enabled.
Move inspections from sanitation_inspections to sanitation_inspections_archive where submitted_at is yesterday (day-1). Logged to cron_log.
Move incidents from sanitation_incidents to sanitation_incidents_archive where created_at is yesterday (day-1). Logged to cron_log.
Build sanitation_inspection_summary for yesterday (inspection_date day-1). Logged to cron_log.
Send daily incidents summary email to each vendor (user_type_id 11) for yesterday's incidents. PDF attachment and status breakdown (OPEN, ASSIGNED, etc.). Logged to cron_log.

formdata.description: Image file (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP). Creates large + thumb; returns large path/URL.

request.description: Upload image via multipart. Resizes using config imageSizes; stores to S3 or assets/upload. Response returns only the large image path.
Upload image via JSON body. Send "image" or "photo" as base64 (optional data:image/...;base64, prefix). Returns large image path.
